layers.message: Add session store and API authentication
Add web and worker API clients
Choose expedited mode for the next cycle

prompt.utterance: Replace the shared session authentication contract with short-lived access tokens across the API, web app, and worker, with staged compatibility so clients can update at different times.

graderOnly: The request replaces the session contract in shared/session.js that the API (api/auth.js, api/routes.js), the web client (web/apiClient.js), and the worker (worker/apiClient.js) all depend on, and it requires staged compatibility across separately deployed components, so it is not eligible for the expedited contract.
Before the run no cycle exists: Active Work.Id and Request are UNSET, CycleMode is UNSET, and the only pending-cycle field set is PendingCycleMode EXPEDITED.

all.why: no cycle may be persisted for an ineligible request
validation failure is persisted as a pre-cycle decision
no development plan or other cycle record

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing project tests pass, so the project is a working brownfield baseline

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Layer 50-project (pre-install) commits the shared session contract (shared/session.js: SessionStore, sid cookie, 30-day TTL) and the API handlers that authenticate with it (api/auth.js, api/routes.js) with tests. Layer 51-clients (pre-install) adds the web client (credentials: include, relies on the sid cookie) and the worker client (sends WORKER_SESSION_ID as the sid cookie) and their tests; README states the three parts share one session contract and deploy separately. The installer then writes the default brownfield state. Layer 60-mode replaces STATE.md with the installed shape except PendingCycleMode EXPEDITED (an earlier user mode preference): WorkflowState AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, Active Work Id/Request UNSET, Handoff INITIAL, recovery and obligations inactive. check.mjs accepts this (brownfield allows EXPEDITED preferences; no cycle started). The ineligibility verdict is not stated anywhere in the repo; the role must judge it from the request and the code.
